QuestInfo.name: [The Afterland] Night Time is the Right Time (To Party)
QuestInfo.0: From the moment you arrived in the 'Land of Warriors,' you found yourself under siege. Now, the battle is finally over.
QuestInfo.1:
From the moment you arrived in the 'Land of Warriors,' you found yourself under siege. Now, the battle is finally over. It seems that in this place, emerging victorious in battle grants you the title of #e'Greatest Warrior Ever.'#n 

It is this warrior alone who decides the passage of time. #bIf you wish to change night into day, or day into night, all you need to do is become the Greatest Warrior Ever.#k
